detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

DHX / PNB-0408 (Encapsulated Solid)

Chemical Information:
  • Compound Name: DHX
  • Alternate Identifier: PNB-0408
  • Compound Class: Synthetic peptide-derived small molecule
  • Chemical Type: Modified oligopeptide derivative

Structural Description:
N-hexanoyl-Tyr-Ile-(6-aminohexanoic amide)
(Exact molecular formula and molecular weight are batch-specific and provided in the Certificate of Analysis.)

Molecular Structure:
Product Description:

PNB-0408 is a synthetic peptide-derived compound produced through chemical modification of a short amino-acid sequence. It is supplied as a solid research material intended for controlled analytical and mechanistic investigation within laboratory research environments.

This product is provided in an encapsulated solid format to support controlled storage, handling, and analytical preparation. The encapsulated format functions solely as a physical containment and presentation method and does not imply any route of administration or intended method of use.

PNB-0408 is intended exclusively for controlled in-vitro laboratory research conducted by qualified professionals working with experimental peptide-derived compounds.

Research Applications:
  • In-vitro studies involving peptide-derived compound stability and behavior
  • Analytical method development for modified oligopeptide research materials
  • Laboratory evaluation of structure–property relationships in synthetic peptide analogues
  • Comparative research involving chemically modified short-sequence compounds
Storage and Handling:
  • Store in a cool, dry environment away from direct light
  • Maintain container tightly sealed when not in use
  • Handle using appropriate laboratory safety and aseptic techniques
Product Specifications:
  • Analytical Approach to Finished Formulations: Purity is a metric used for isolated raw materials, such as lyophilized peptide powders. Finished formulations—such as capsules, liquids, and topicals—contain multiple components, including excipients and stabilizers. In these systems, a single purity value does not accurately represent the overall composition. Instead, identity and assay (content) are reported on the COA to confirm the presence of the correct compound and to verify that the labeled amount per unit is accurate. This approach reflects standard analytical practice and provides more meaningful information for research applications.
  • Format: Encapsulated solid research compound
  • Appearance: White to off-white solid
  • Solubility: Soluble in appropriate laboratory solvents following removal from the encapsulation format for analytical use
Compliance Notice:

PNB-0408 is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
